headlines.headline: NBA's Clippers cap-circumvention probe tied to Kawhi Leonard stays in focus
headlines.detail: The league's long-running review of the Clippers' defunct courtside-sponsorship arrangement and its ties to Kawhi Leonard remains active. Four games on tonight's slate, including Pistons at Knicks.

headlines.headline: Falcons CB James Pearce Jr. suspended 8 games for personal conduct policy violation
headlines.detail: The suspension lands amid an active trade season — Giants acquired QB J.J. McCarthy, Steelers sent CB Joey Porter Jr. to Dallas — with the Nov. 10 trade deadline two weeks out.

headlines.headline: Playoff picture tightens heading into Week 9 as undefeateds dwindle
headlines.detail: BYU's comeback win over Notre Dame still reshapes the four-team conversation. Washington's first-ever Big Ten meeting with Nebraska on Saturday adds another data point before the first CFP rankings.

headlines.headline: Former Louisville coach Kenny Payne joins Calipari's Arkansas staff ahead of season opener
headlines.detail: The hire comes days after Florida was tabbed preseason No. 1 for the first time since 2006. Season tips off Nov. 2.
